ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (black) pixels to 25% high-intensity (white) pixels localized primarily at the distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the outer lateral thirds of both lobes, transitioning into high-frequency white-on-black mottling toward the central dark core.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire continuous boundary; amplitude of peaks is greatest near the distal tips, becoming more subtle toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the outer leading edges with a multi-inflected convex trajectory along the trailing edge from notch to tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast circular white clusters localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; smaller isolated circular spots distributed across the dark medial regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple short, non-parallel linear high-intensity disruptions visible on the dark ventral surface, including a distinct diagonal mark on the left medial lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged erosion of the fluke tips; scattered punctate white scars distributed across the central dark pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, isolated white pixel cluster on the inner lower-left lobe, separated from the main lateral white region.
